items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, but there's a guy named Walter Allen is going through all, you know, the Baltimore for America. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Well, most of the Negro papers had carried big stories.

ctx.x: The Pittsburgh Courier was the biggest thing then, the Chicago Defender. I think most of those papers, the Pittsburgh Courier is still going, but I think the Chicago Defender has been deleted years ago.
Yeah, but there's a guy named Walter Allen is going through all, you know, the Baltimore for America.

Yeah. Well, most of the Negro papers had carried big stories. However, every white newspaper carried the stories when they came to town. Unfortunately, I didn't keep all of these write-ups, you know. You do have some scrapbooks, though, is it?
